input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to comma-separated file containing information about the samples in the experiment.
input.help_text: You will need to create a design file with information about the samples in your experiment before running the pipeline. Use this parameter to specify its location. It has to be a comma-separated file with 4 columns, and a header row. See [usage docs](https://nf-co.re/rnasplice/usage#samplesheet-input). For paired differential splicing analyses, the samples in the design file should be ordered such that the same individuals are in the same order for both conditions. For example, if you have 3 case-control pairs, then the first 3 samples in the design file should be the case samples and the next 3 samples should be the corresponding control samples, in the same order as the case samples.

contrasts.description: Path to comma-separated file containing information about the contrasts in the experiment.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

email.help_text: Set this parameter to your e-mail address to get a summary e-mail with details of the run sent to you when the workflow exits. If set in your user config file (`~/.nextflow/config`) then you don't need to specify this on the command line for every run.

multiqc_title.description: MultiQC report title. Printed as page header, used for filename if not otherwise specified.

save_merged_fastq.description: Save FastQ files after merging re-sequenced libraries in the results directory.

reference_genome_options.title: Reference genome options
reference_genome_options.description: Reference genome related files and options required for the workflow.

genome.help_text:
If using a reference genome configured in the pipeline using iGenomes, use this parameter to give the ID for the reference. This is then used to build the full paths for all required reference genome files e.g. `--genome GRCh38`. 

See the [nf-core website docs](https://nf-co.re/usage/reference_genomes) for more details.

fasta.help_text: This parameter is *mandatory* if `--genome` is not specified. If you don't have a BWA index available this will be generated for you automatically. Combine with `--save_reference` to save BWA index for future runs.

gtf.help_text: This parameter is *mandatory* if `--genome` is not specified.

gff.help_text: This parameter must be specified if `--genome` or `--gtf` are not specified.

star_index.description: Path to directory or tar.gz archive for pre-built STAR index.

salmon_index.description: Path to directory or tar.gz archive for pre-built Salmon index.

gencode.description: Specify if your transcript FASTA file is in GENCODE format.
gencode.help_text: If your file is in GENCODE format and you would like to run Salmon i.e. `--pseudo_aligner salmon`, you will need to provide this parameter in order to build the Salmon index appropriately.

gtf_extra_attributes.description: By default, the pipeline uses the gene_name field to obtain additional gene identifiers from the input GTF file when running Salmon.

gtf_group_features.description: Define the attribute type used to group features in the GTF file when running Salmon.

save_reference.description: If generated by the pipeline save the STAR index in the results directory.
save_reference.help_text: If an alignment index is generated by the pipeline use this parameter to save it to your results folder. These can then be used for future pipeline runs, reducing processing times.

igenomes_ignore.description: Do not load the iGenomes reference config.
igenomes_ignore.help_text: Do not load `igenomes.config` when running the pipeline. You may choose this option if you observe clashes between custom parameters and those supplied in `igenomes.config`.

igenomes_base.description: The base path to the igenomes reference files

institutional_config_options.title: Institutional config options
institutional_config_options.description: Parameters used to describe centralised config profiles. These should not be edited.
institutional_config_options.help_text: The centralised nf-core configuration profiles use a handful of pipeline parameters to describe themselves. This information is then printed to the Nextflow log when you run a pipeline. You should not need to change these values when you run a pipeline.

custom_config_version.description: Git commit id for Institutional configs.

custom_config_base.help_text: If you're running offline, Nextflow will not be able to fetch the institutional config files from the internet. If you don't need them, then this is not a problem. If you do need them, you should download the files from the repo and tell Nextflow where to find them with this parameter.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

email_on_fail.description: Email address for completion summary, only when pipeline fails.
email_on_fail.help_text: An email address to send a summary email to when the pipeline is completed - ONLY sent if the pipeline does not exit successfully.

plaintext_email.description: Send plain-text email instead of HTML.

max_multiqc_email_size.description: File size limit when attaching MultiQC reports to summary emails.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

multiqc_config.description: Custom config file to supply to MultiQC.

multiqc_logo.description: Custom logo file to supply to MultiQC. File name must also be set in the MultiQC config file

multiqc_methods_description.description: Custom MultiQC yaml file containing HTML including a methods description.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

pipelines_testdata_base_path.description: Base path for the test data directory.

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format `yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss`.

help_full.description: Display the full detailed help message.

show_hidden.description: Display hidden parameters in the help message (only works when --help or --help_full are provided).

read_trimming_options.title: Read trimming options
read_trimming_options.description: Options to adjust read trimming criteria.

clip_r1.description: Instructs Trim Galore to remove bp from the 5' end of read 1 (or single-end reads).

clip_r2.description: Instructs Trim Galore to remove bp from the 5' end of read 2 (paired-end reads only).

three_prime_clip_r1.description: Instructs Trim Galore to remove bp from the 3' end of read 1 AFTER adapter/quality trimming has been performed.

three_prime_clip_r2.description: Instructs Trim Galore to remove bp from the 3' end of read 2 AFTER adapter/quality trimming has been performed.

trim_nextseq.help_text: This enables the option Cutadapt `--nextseq-trim=3'CUTOFF` option via Trim Galore, which will set a quality cutoff (that is normally given with -q instead), but qualities of G bases are ignored. This trimming is in common for the NextSeq- and NovaSeq-platforms, where basecalls without any signal are called as high-quality G bases.
trim_nextseq.description: Instructs Trim Galore to apply the --nextseq=X option, to trim based on quality after removing poly-G tails.

save_trimmed.description: Save the trimmed FastQ files in the results directory.

skip_trimming.description: Use this if your input FastQ files have already been trimmed outside of the workflow or if you're very confident that there is no adapter contamination in your data.

min_trimmed_reads.description: Minimum number of trimmed reads below which samples are flagged in multiqc output.

qc_options.title: QC options
qc_options.description: Defube QC options required for the workflow.

strand_check.description: Check the strandedness of each sample against the one RSeQC infer_experiment.py infers from the genome BAM.
strand_check.help_text: Mismatches are reported as warnings and in a 'Strandedness Checks' table in the MultiQC report. Requires genome alignments, from `--aligner` or `--source genome_bam`.

alignment_options.title: Alignment options
alignment_options.description: Options to adjust parameters and filtering criteria for read alignments.

aligner.description: Specifies the alignment algorithm to use.

pseudo_aligner.description: Specifies the pseudo aligner to use. Runs in addition to `--aligner`.

bam_csi_index.description: Create a CSI index for BAM files instead of the traditional BAI index. This will be required for genomes with larger chromosome sizes.

star_ignore_sjdbgtf.description: When using pre-built STAR indices do not re-extract and use splice junctions from the GTF file.

salmon_quant_libtype.description: Override Salmon library type inferred based on strandedness defined in meta object.

stranded_threshold.description: The fraction of stranded reads that must be assigned to a strandedness for confident assignment. Must be at least 0.5.
stranded_threshold.help_text: Used to infer the strandedness of samples set to 'auto' in the samplesheet with Salmon, and by `--strand_check` with RSeQC.

unstranded_threshold.description: The difference in fraction of stranded reads assigned to 'forward' and 'reverse' below which a sample is classified as 'unstranded'.
unstranded_threshold.help_text: By default the forward and reverse fractions must differ by less than 0.1 for the sample to be called as unstranded. A sample that is neither stranded nor unstranded by these thresholds is undetermined, and analysed as unstranded.

seq_center.description: Sequencing center information to be added to read group of BAM files.

skip_alignment.description: Skip all of the alignment-based processes within the pipeline.

save_unaligned.description: Where possible, save unaligned reads from either STAR or Salmon to the results directory.

save_align_intermeds.description: Save the intermediate BAM files from the alignment step.
save_align_intermeds.help_text: By default, intermediate BAM files will not be saved. The final BAM files created after the appropriate filtering step are always saved to limit storage usage. Set this parameter to also save other intermediate BAM files.

leafcutter_options.title: Leafcutter options
leafcutter_options.description: Options for the LeafCutter splicing quantification.

aspli_options.title: ASpli options
aspli_options.description: Options for the ASpli differential bin and junction usage analysis.

aspli.help_text: Run [ASpli](https://bioconductor.org/packages/ASpli) on the genome BAM files, with `--aligner star` or `--aligner star_salmon`, or with `--source genome_bam`. ASpli bins the genome from the GTF, counts reads over genes, bins and junctions, tests each contrast of the contrastsheet for differential bin and junction usage, and integrates the bin and junction signals of each region into one report. The samples must be all single end or all paired end, and the samplesheet needs at least two conditions.

aspli_read_len.description: Minimum read length given to ASpli. Estimated from the BAM files when not set.
aspli_read_len.help_text: ASpli only counts a read over an exon-intron boundary when it overlaps the boundary by at least this many bases, so it must not be longer than the reads. When it is not set, it is the 5th percentile of the lengths of all the primary mapped reads of each BAM file, taken from the BAM file with the shortest reads.

rmats_splice_diff_cutoff.description: The cutoff used in the null hypothesis test for differential splicing.

rmats_paired_stats.description: Use paired statistical model. It requires that the same individuals are measured in both conditions.
rmats_paired_stats.help_text:
Use the paired statistical model in rMATS. This is appropriate when the same individuals are measured in both conditions, for example in a case-control study design. If your study design is not paired, set this to `false` to use the unpaired model. The paired model requires that the samples in the samplesheet are ordered such that the same individuals are in the same order for both conditions. For example, if you have 3 case-control pairs, then the first 3 samples in the samplesheet should be the case samples and the next 3 samples should be the corresponding control samples, in the same order as the case samples:

```csv
sample,fastq_1,fastq_2,strandedness,condition
TREATMENT_SAMPLE_A,TX_SAMPLE_A_R1_001.fastq.gz,TX_SAMPLE_A_R2_001.fastq.gz,forward,treatment
TREATMENT_SAMPLE_B,TX_SAMPLE_B_R1_001.fastq.gz,TX_SAMPLE_B_R2_001.fastq.gz,forward,treatment
TREATMENT_SAMPLE_C,TX_SAMPLE_C_R1_001.fastq.gz,TX_SAMPLE_C_R2_001.fastq.gz,forward,treatment
CONTROL_SAMPLE_A,CTRL_SAMPLE_A_R1_001.fastq.gz,CTRL_SAMPLE_A_R2_001.fastq.gz,forward,control
CONTROL_SAMPLE_B,CTRL_SAMPLE_B_R1_001.fastq.gz,CTRL_SAMPLE_B_R2_001.fastq.gz,forward,control
CONTROL_SAMPLE_C,CTRL_SAMPLE_C_R1_001.fastq.gz,CTRL_SAMPLE_C_R2_001.fastq.gz,forward,control

```
Similar order must be followed when `--source genome_bam` or `--source transcriptome_bam`.

rmats_novel_splice_site.description: Detect splicing events that involve an unannotated splice site.

dexseq_exon.description: Run DEXSeq differential exon usage workflow.

alignment_quality.description: Minimum alignment quality required for reads to be counted.

aggregation.description: Combine overlapping genes into a single aggregate gene.

save_dexseq_plot.description: Save plots of the per gene DEXSeq results.

n_dexseq_plot.description: Plot the N most significant genes from the DEXSeq results.

save_edger_plot.description: Save plots of the per gene edgeR results.

n_edger_plot.description: Plot the N most significant genes from the edgeR results.

dexseq_dtu.description: Run DEXSeq differential transcript usage workflow.

dtu_txi.description: Abundance estimates used to generate the estimated counts.

min_samps_gene_expr.description: Minimal number of samples where genes should be expressed.

min_samps_feature_expr.description: Minimal number of samples where features should be expressed.

min_samps_feature_prop.description: Minimal number of samples where features should have at least the proportion `--min_feature_prop`.

min_feature_prop.description: Minimal proportion for feature expression. This value should be between 0 and 1.

ignore_tx_version.description: Ignore transcript version numbers when matching Salmon quantification output to tx2gene file.
ignore_tx_version.help_text: When enabled, transcript IDs with a version suffix (e.g. `.1` in `ENST00000335137.1`) are matched to the same ID without it (e.g. `ENST00000335137`), and the transcript IDs in the tximport tables lose their version. Use this when the Salmon quantification and the tx2gene file disagree on transcript versions, for example a GENCODE transcript FASTA with an Ensembl GTF. Leave it off when both carry the same IDs, as SUPPA matches the transcript IDs of the GTF.

miso.title: MISO options
miso.description: Options for the MISO sashimi plots.

miso_genes.description: List containing identifiers of genes to plot.

miso_genes_file.description: New-line separate file containing identifiers of genes to plot.

miso_read_len.description: Read length used to calculate coverage.

suppa_per_local_event.description: Quantify event inclusion levels (PSIs) from multiple samples.

suppa_per_isoform.description: Quantify isoform inclusion levels (PSIs) from multiple samples.

suppa_tpm.help_text: An example can be found at "${projectDir}/assets/tpm.txt"
suppa_tpm.description: Expression file containing the abundances of all transcripts (ideally in TPM units).

generateevents_pool_genes.description: Redefine genes by clustering together transcripts by genomic stranded overlap and sharing at least one exon.

generateevents_event_type.description: Space separated list of events to generate.

generateevents_boundary.description: Boundary type (only used for local AS events).

generateevents_exon_length.description: Defines the number of nucleotides to display in the output GTF.

psiperevent_total_filter.description: Minimum total expression of the transcripts involved in the event.

diffsplice_local_event.description: Calculate differential splicing for AS events across multiple conditions with replicates.

diffsplice_isoform.description: Calculate differential splicing for differential transcript usage across multiple conditions with replicates

diffsplice_method.description: The method to use to calculate the significance.

diffsplice_area.description: Number of points in the local area of the delta PSI - average TPM distribution.

diffsplice_lower_bound.description: Lower-bound for the absolute delta PSI value to test for significance.

diffsplice_paired.description: Indicates if replicates across conditions are paired.

diffsplice_alpha.description: Family-wise error rate to use for the multiple test correction.

diffsplice_median.description: Use the median to calculate the Delta PSI, instead of the mean.

diffsplice_tpm_threshold.description: Minimum expression (calculated as average TPM value within-replicates and between-conditions) to be included in the analysis.

diffsplice_nan_threshold.description: Proportion of samples with nan values allowed per condition to calculate a delta PSI.

clusterevents_local_event.description: Cluster events according to PSI values across conditions

clusterevents_isoform.description: Cluster transcripts according to PSI values across conditions

clusterevents_sigthreshold.description: P-value threshold to consider an event significant from the dpsi file.

clusterevents_dpsithreshold.description: Lower-bound for the absolute delta PSI value to cluster.

clusterevents_eps.description: Maximum distance (between 0 and 1) to consider two events as members of the same cluster.

clusterevents_separation.description: Maximum distance in PSI space of an event to a cluster.

clusterevents_min_pts.description: Minimum number of events required per cluster.

isoformswitchanalyzer.title: IsoformSwitchAnalyzeR options
isoformswitchanalyzer.description: Options for the IsoformSwitchAnalyzeR isoform switch analysis.

isoformswitchanalyzer_alpha.description: Alpha value for differential isoform expression.

isoformswitchanalyzer_dIF.description: dIF cutoff value for differential isoform expression.
